title: Food tour and history lesson
text: The tour combined an informative history lesson with good food. It's also a great way to see parts of Barcelona that you may miss by just walking around. Vera was an excellent guide.
author: Detroiter_in_FL

title: Barcelona Food Tour with Alex
text: Alex was our guide and he was excellent.  Very knowledgeable and entertaining.  It was a small group tour so an intimate group.  We went to 3 places that we never would have found on our own.
author: Holly_B

title: Enhance your Barcelona experience
text: I had a wonderful evening with Vera. She shared lots of history and cultural insights as she guided me around the Gothic Quarter. The tapas and wine were all excellent. I definitely recommend this tour!
author: U7126JRsusanm

title: Great tapas/drinks tour
text: Vera did an excellent job guiding us through the tour. She picked fun and delicious places for us to stop at and sample the drinks/tapas. She is knowledgeable and knows her material. It was obvious she is extremely passionate about Spain and its food. We really enjoyed our time.
author: P9927RRkats

title: Great guide, great food!
text: Hector is a great tour guide! He is fun, conversational, and very knowledgeable. Takes you to all the best spots, and works with the restaurants to help with guests’ dietary restrictions. Certainly the best tour I took in Barcelona!
author: Timothy_D

title: Alexandria was an amazing...
text: Alexandria was an amazing guide. We learned a lot about tapas and the delicious wines of Barcelona. She was extremely knowledgeable and friendly. Highly recommend this tour.  Five star to Alexandria
author: Julie_S

title: Over the top!
text: I just want to say this was probably the best food and history tour I have ever taken. Alexandra was a amazing guide.  Very knowledgeable and just a delight to be with. She made the tour so much fun! Thank you for making my first visit to Barcelona a amazing one! For anyone booking I hope you get her she was great!!
author: cwenzel123

title: Highly Recommend!
text: Fabulous night out in Barcelona! My friend and I had such a great time on this tour. Dani was a fanulous guide and gave us a great balance of history and fun. The food locations were fabulous. We met some nice guys on the tour and even had a few drinks with them after. Great environment to meet people, learn about Barcelona, and enjoy authentic Catalan food and wine culture. Thank you!
author: marykatefitz4

title: Don't miss this food tour!
text: Emma was a delightful, knowledgeable guide! She walked us through the Gothic Quarter, stopping at 5 taverns frequented by locals, where we got to sample tasty tapas and delicious Spanish wine. We enjoyed hearing about the food, culture, and history of the city, and had a great time getting to know the other people in the group. We highly recommend this tour!
author: Lisa_M

title: Alex is by far an amazing...
text: Alex is by far an amazing guide! The food and drinks were fantastic. Learning about the history of Barcelona was really interesting. What truly makes this an amazing tour is Alex's restaurant recommendations at the end. Every single one was is hand picked and truly a gem. If like us you do this tour on your first night you will eat well during your whole stay.
author: SofiaEleni_C
